facts.fact: gmCSIRT, the Gambia Computer Security Incident Response Team, describes itself as the national CSIRT, a government agency founded in 2020, advising operators of critical information infrastructure; date used is the post's published date.

systems.country_label: The Gambia Computer Security Incident Response Team (gmCSIRT)

note: Training programme of May 2026 is not a fact; no designation of critical information infrastructure, incident or figures stated.
